description: Compute the tax stamp on a lawyer's power of attorney (وکالت‌نامه, article 103 of the Direct Taxes Act) and the fund and Bar shares paid with it, for one stage of one case, civil or criminal. Use it when the question is what the stamp costs; for the lawyer's tariff fee use calculate_lawyer_fee, and for court fees calculate_court_fee. Returns the amounts and their breakdown. Amounts in rial; dates in the Jalali calendar.

case_kind.description: family covers امور حسبی and the financial claims of a marriage — mehrieh and نفقه are family, not financial. non_judicial is a هیأت such as قانون کار.

claim_amount_rial.description: بهای خواسته, in ریال. Only a financial claim has one.

contract_fee_rial.description: The حق‌الوکاله written in the وکالت‌نامه, in ریال. Left out, the stamp is computed on the tariff for that stage, which is also its floor.

criminal_band.description: Which band the gravest charge falls in. court1 is کیفری یک، نظامی یک و انقلاب; court2 is کیفری دو، نظامی دو و اطفال.

extra_charges.description: Charges beyond the gravest one, in a criminal case.

government_client.description: The client is a ministry, a state company or a شهرداری.

membership.description: bar is کانون وکلای دادگستری, markaz is مرکز وکلا؛ they owe different shares. bar when not said.

stage.description: A civil matter is first, appeal, supreme or enforcement. A criminal one is prosecution (دادسرا), first, appeal, order_objection (اعتراض به قرار) or cassation.

name: calculate_stamp_duty

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.

title: Lawyer's power-of-attorney stamp duty (تمبر وکالت)
